message:
So the issue is that `fuzz_as.c` calls `read_begin()` but never calls `obstack_begin (&notes, chunksize)`. The `notes` obstack is a global that is zero-initialized. When `read_begin` -> `pobegin` -> ... eventually calls `str_htab_create` -> `htab_create_alloc` -> `notes_calloc` -> `notes_alloc` -> `obstack_alloc (&notes, size)`, it dereferences the zeroed `notes` obstack, causing a null-dereference READ.

Let me look at `pobegin` to understand the call chain:

<｜｜DSML｜｜>
<parameter=command>grep -n "pobegin" /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/binutils-gdb/gas/read.c | head -3 && sed -n '/^pobegin/,/^}/p' /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/binutils-gdb/gas/read.c | head -40</parameter>
</｜｜DSML｜｜>
